title: The Grapes of Wrath
author: John Steinbeck
summary: Driven off their Oklahoma farm during the Dust Bowl, the Joad family packs everything it owns into a truck and heads for California, hoping for work and finding hostility and exploitation instead.
readIf: you want a powerful, angry Depression-era novel about ordinary people and solidarity.
skipIf: you want a hopeful ending or plot over social commentary.

pairings.reason: A shorter, tighter Steinbeck story about migrant workers and fragile dreams.
A modern novel about the same era and migration, more emotional and plot-driven.
Another American epic about a long journey, with more humour and warmth.
